Name: FOOT_SFX_PARAM_ST
Description: Footstep SFX by floor material. The row ID is the floor's hit material ID (the HitMtrlParam row the character stands on); each column is a foot effect ID, from a TAE foot-effect event or the character's automatic footsteps. A material with no row plays nothing. Retail IDs follow (100 + material) × 1000 + foot effect ID.
